parts.note_add: The 1985 workshop manual (S-002 p.7B-79, L4N71B) draws where every thrust needle bearing and race sits in the case; the 3N71B positions behind the overdrive section are the same layout.
Six selective races, 1.2-2.2 mm in 0.2 mm steps; total end play is read with a dial indicator on the input shaft while the connecting shell is levered fore and aft.

Front clutch drum end play is measured with a feeler gauge between the front clutch drum and the connecting shell; the catalogue lists eight washers (1.3-2.7 mm) while the 1980 manual lists seven (1.5-2.7 mm).
Aftermarket 3N71B overhaul (soft parts) kits listing the 1979-85 RX-7 are available, e.g. Cobra 53002F.
The 1985 workshop manual (S-002 p.7B-56) has an exploded view of the connecting drum, rear planetary carrier and one-way clutch with the removal order.
Fit with the arrow mark toward the front of the car; it must turn freely in one direction only (clockwise, 1980 manual).
Its eight bolts are reached from the case side with Mazda hex socket 49 0378 346.
Six selective plates, 7.8-8.8 mm in 0.2 mm steps; clearance to the snap ring is checked with a feeler gauge.
The secondary governor spring is the stronger of the two and must not be swapped with the primary; the valves should slide in their bores under their own weight when dry.

specs.item: Planetary gear side play (pinion washer to carrier), limit
specs.note: Beyond the limit the carrier is replaced as a unit (1980 manual 7A:14).

specs.item: Pinion washer to carrier clearance, standard
specs.note: 1980 manual; S-038 gives only the 0.8 mm limit, which matches.

specs.item: Total end play (gear assembly)
specs.note: Set by the pump cover bearing race thickness; 1980 manual 7A:16 gives the same figure and the method.

specs.item: Pump cover bearing race thicknesses available
specs.note: Same six sizes in the 1980 manual 7A:16. Fitted thickness: check at teardown.

specs.item: Front clutch drum end play
specs.note: Set by the front clutch thrust washer; measured between front clutch drum and connecting shell (1980 manual 7A:16).

specs.item: Front clutch thrust washer thicknesses available
specs.note: The 1980 manual 7A:16 lists 1.5-2.7 mm only (no 1.3). Fitted thickness: check at teardown.

specs.item: Low and reverse brake friction (drive) plate thickness, limit
Replacement Raybestos R560160: low/reverse friction plate
specs.note: Listed for L3N71B (OEM ref 31662-X0102); check fit against the Mazda 3N71B plate before buying.

specs.item: Replacement Raybestos STMMAZDA01: steel plate module
specs.note: Mazda-specific steel module; the 4 low/reverse count matches the catalogue qty 4.

specs.item: Low and reverse brake clearance (retaining plate to snap ring)
specs.note: Adjusted by retaining plate thickness; same in 1980 manual 7A:8 and 1985 manual 7B-67.

specs.item: Retaining plate thicknesses available
specs.note: Same six sizes in the 1980 manual 7A:8. Fitted thickness: check at teardown.

specs.item: One-way clutch inner race bolt torque
specs.note: 1985 manual (9.4-13.0 ft-lb); 1980 manual 7A:8 gives 1.3-1.8 m-kg (9-13 ft-lb), the same. Check the return spring, thrust washer and rings are seated before tightening.

specs.item: Governor pressure at 20 mph (output shaft 1,070-1,190 rpm)
Governor pressure at 35 mph (output shaft 1,940-2,100 rpm)
Governor pressure at 55 mph (output shaft 3,100-3,300 rpm)
Governor body to oil distributor bolt torque
specs.note: 1980 manual gives 0.5-0.7 m-kg (3.6-5.1 ft-lb); 1985 manual 7B-58 gives 5-7 N·m for its 4 bolts.

specs.item: Primary governor spring
specs.value: coil OD 8.75, 5 coils, free length 21.8, fitting constant 0.215 kg
specs.note: 1980 manual; 1985 manual 7B-58 gives free length 21.8 mm.

specs.item: Secondary governor spring
specs.value: coil OD 9.2, 5.5 coils, free length 25.1, fitting constant 1.10 kg
specs.note: 1980 manual; 1985 manual 7B-58 gives 9.2 mm OD and 25.1 mm free length, the same.

specs.item: Seal ring to groove side clearance (oil distributor)
specs.note: 1980 manual; 1985 manual 7B-58 gives the same standard and a limit of 0.40 mm.

specs.item: Seal ring to groove side clearance, limit
specs.note: 1985 L4N71B manual only.

specs.item: Installation direction
specs.value: arrow mark toward the front of the car; free to turn clockwise only
specs.note: 1985 manual 7B-56 gives the same arrow-forward rule.

specs.item: Replacement Cobra 53002F: 3N71B/L3N71B overhaul kit (no bonded pistons)
specs.note: Contains paper and rubber gaskets, O-rings, lip seals, metal-clad seals and sealing rings; lists 1979-85 RX-7. Price as listed 2026-09.
